verses.en: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.
verses.pt: Depois chamou Jacó a seus filhos, e disse: Ajuntai-vos para que eu vos anuncie o que vos há de acontecer nos dias vindouros.
verses.en_web: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob sent for his sons, and said, Come together, all of you, so that I may give you news of your fate in future times.

verses.en: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.
verses.pt: Ajuntai-vos, e ouvi, filhos de Jacó; ouvi a Israel vosso pai:
verses.en_web: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.
verses.en_bbe: Come near, O sons of Jacob, and give ear to the words of Israel your father.

verses.en: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
verses.pt: Rúben, tu és meu primogênito, minha força e as primícias do meu vigor, preeminente em dignidade e preeminente em poder.
verses.en_web: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength; excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.
verses.en_bbe: Reuben, you are my oldest son, the first-fruit of my strength, first in pride and first in power:

verses.en: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.
verses.pt: Descomedido como a àgua, não reterás a preeminência; porquanto subiste ao leito de teu pai; então o contaminaste. Sim, ele subiu à minha cama.
verses.en_web: Boiling over like water, you shall not excel; because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.
verses.en_bbe: But because you were uncontrolled, the first place will not be yours; for you went up to your father's bed, even his bride-bed, and made it unclean.

verses.en: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
verses.pt: Simeão e Levi são irmãos; as suas espadas são instrumentos de violência.
verses.en_web: “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.
verses.en_bbe: Simeon and Levi are brothers; deceit and force are their secret designs.

verses.en: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.
verses.pt: No seu concílio não entres, ó minha alma! com a sua assembléia não te ajuntes, ó minha glória! porque no seu furor mataram homens, e na sua teima jarretaram bois.
verses.en_web: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.
verses.en_bbe: Take no part in their secrets, O my soul; keep far away, O my heart, from their meetings; for in their wrath they put men to death, and for their pleasure even oxen were wounded.

verses.en: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
verses.pt: Maldito o seu furor, porque era forte! maldita a sua ira, porque era cruel! Dividi-los-ei em Jacó, e os espalharei em Israel.
verses.en_web: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
verses.en_bbe: A curse on their passion for it was bitter; and on their wrath for it was cruel. I will let their heritage in Jacob be broken up, driving them from their places in Israel.

verses.en: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father’s children shall bow down before thee.
verses.pt: Judá, a ti te louvarão teus irmãos; a tua mão será sobre o pescoço de teus inimigos: diante de ti se prostrarão os filhos de teu pai.
verses.en_web: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.
verses.en_bbe: To you, Judah, will your brothers give praise: your hand will be on the neck of your haters; your father's sons will go down to the earth before you.

verses.en: Judah is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
verses.pt: Judá é um leãozinho. Subiste da presa, meu filho. Ele se encurva e se deita como um leão, e como uma leoa; quem o despertará?
verses.en_web: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?
verses.en_bbe: Judah is a young lion; like a lion full of meat you have become great, my son; now he takes his rest like a lion stretched out and like an old lion; by whom will his sleep be broken?

verses.en: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
verses.pt: O cetro não se arredará de Judà, nem o bastão de autoridade dentre seus pés, até que venha aquele a quem pertence; e a ele obedecerão os povos.
verses.en_web: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. To him will the obedience of the peoples be.
verses.en_bbe: The rod of authority will not be taken from Judah, and he will not be without a law-giver, till he comes who has the right to it, and the peoples will put themselves under his rule.

verses.en: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass’s colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:
verses.pt: Atando ele o seu jumentinho à vide, e o filho da sua jumenta à videira seleta, lava as suas roupas em vinho e a sua vestidura em sangue de uvas.
verses.en_web: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine; he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
verses.en_bbe: Knotting his ass's cord to the vine, and his young ass to the best vine; washing his robe in wine, and his clothing in the blood of grapes:

verses.en: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
verses.pt: Os olhos serão escurecidos pelo vinho, e os dentes brancos de leite.
verses.en_web: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.
verses.en_bbe: His eyes will be dark with wine, and his teeth white with milk.

verses.en: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.
verses.pt: Zebulom habitarà no litoral; será ele ancoradouro de navios; e o seu termo estender-se-á até Sidom.
verses.en_web: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.
verses.en_bbe: The resting-place of Zebulun will be by the sea, and he will be a harbour for ships; the edge of his land will be by Zidon.

verses.en: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
verses.pt: Issacar é jumento forte, deitado entre dois fardos.
verses.en_web: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.
verses.en_bbe: Issachar is a strong ass stretched out among the flocks:

verses.en: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
verses.pt: Viu ele que o descanso era bom, e que a terra era agradável. Sujeitou os seus ombros à carga e entregou-se ao serviço forçado de um escravo.
verses.en_web: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.
verses.en_bbe: And he saw that rest was good and the land was pleasing; so he let them put weights on his back and became a servant.

verses.en: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.pt: Dã julgará o seu povo, como uma das tribos de Israel.
verses.en_web: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Dan will be the judge of his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

verses.en: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.
verses.pt: Dã será serpente junto ao caminho, uma víbora junto à vereda, que morde os calcanhares do cavalo, de modo que caia o seu cavaleiro para trás.
verses.en_web: Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, That bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.
verses.en_bbe: May Dan be a snake in the way, a horned snake by the road, biting the horse's foot so that the horseman has a fall.

verses.en: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.
verses.pt: A tua salvação tenho esperado, ó Senhor!
verses.en_web: I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: I have been waiting for your salvation, O Lord.

verses.en: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.
verses.pt: Quanto a Gade, guerrilheiros o acometerão; mas ele, por sua vez, os acometerá.
verses.en_web: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.
verses.en_bbe: Gad, an army will come against him, but he will come down on them in their flight.

verses.en: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
verses.pt: De Aser, o seu pão será gordo; ele produzirá delícias reais.
verses.en_web: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.
verses.en_bbe: Asher's bread is fat; he gives delicate food for kings.

verses.en: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
verses.pt: Naftali é uma gazela solta; ele profere palavras formosas.
verses.en_web: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.
verses.en_bbe: Naphtali is a roe let loose, giving fair young ones.

verses.en: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:
verses.pt: José é um ramo frutífero, ramo frutífero junto a uma fonte; seus raminhos se estendem sobre o muro.
verses.en_web: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.
verses.en_bbe: Joseph is a young ox, whose steps are turned to the fountain;

verses.en: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:
verses.pt: Os flecheiros lhe deram amargura, e o flecharam e perseguiram,
verses.en_web: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him:
verses.en_bbe: He was troubled by the archers; they sent out their arrows against him, cruelly wounding him:

verses.en: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)
verses.pt: mas o seu arco permaneceu firme, e os seus braços foram fortalecidos pelas mãos do Poderoso de Jacó, o Pastor, o Rochedo de Israel,
verses.en_web: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),
verses.en_bbe: But their bows were broken by a strong one, and the cords of their arms were cut by the Strength of Jacob, by the name of the Stone of Israel:

verses.en: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:
verses.pt: pelo Deus de teu pai, o qual te ajudará, e pelo Todo-Poderoso, o qual te abençoara, com bênçãos dos céus em cima, com bênçãos do abismo que jaz embaixo, com bênçãos dos seios e da madre.
verses.en_web: even by the God of your father, who will help you; by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.
verses.en_bbe: Even by the God of your father, who will be your help, and by the Ruler of all, who will make you full with blessings from heaven on high, blessings of the deep stretched out under the earth, blessings of the breasts and of the fertile body:

verses.en: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
verses.pt: As bênçãos de teu pai excedem as bênçãos dos montes eternos, as coisas desejadas dos eternos outeiros; sejam elas sobre a cabeça de José, e sobre o alto da cabeça daquele que foi separado de seus irmãos.
verses.en_web: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of your ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.
verses.en_bbe: Blessings of sons, old and young, to the father: blessings of the oldest mountains and the fruit of the eternal hills: let them come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of him who was separate from his brothers.

verses.en: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
verses.pt: Benjamim é lobo que despedaça; pela manhã devorará a presa, e à tarde repartirã o despojo.
verses.en_web: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”
verses.en_bbe: Benjamin is a wolf, searching for meat: in the morning he takes his food, and in the evening he makes division of what he has taken.

verses.en: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
verses.pt: Todas estas são as doze tribos de Israel: e isto é o que lhes falou seu pai quando os abençoou; a cada um deles abençoou segundo a sua bênção.
verses.en_web: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his blessing.
verses.en_bbe: These are the twelve tribes of Israel: and these are the words their father said to them, blessing them; to every one he gave his blessing.

verses.en: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
verses.pt: Depois lhes deu ordem, dizendo-lhes: Eu estou para ser congregado ao meu povo; sepultai-me com meus pais, na cova que está no campo de Efrom, o heteu,
verses.en_web: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
verses.en_bbe: And he gave orders to them, saying, Put me to rest with my people and with my fathers, in the hollow of the rock in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

verses.en: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
verses.pt: na cova que está no campo de Macpela, que está em frente de Manre, na terra de Canaã, cova esta que Abraão comprou de Efrom, o heteu, juntamente com o respectivo campo, como propriedade de sepultura.
verses.en_web: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.
verses.en_bbe: In the rock in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre in the land of Canaan, which Abraham got from Ephron the Hittite, to be his resting-place.

verses.en: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
verses.pt: Ali sepultaram a Abraão e a Sara, sua mulher; ali sepultaram a Isaque e a Rebeca, sua mulher; e ali eu sepultei a Léia.
verses.en_web: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:
verses.en_bbe: There Abraham and Sarah his wife were put to rest, and there they put Isaac and Rebekah his wife, and there I put Leah to rest.

verses.en: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.
verses.pt: O campo e a cova que está nele foram comprados aos filhos de Hete.
verses.en_web: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”
verses.en_bbe: In the rock in the field which was got for a price from the people of Heth.

verses.en: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
verses.pt: Acabando Jacó de dar estas instruçães a seus filhos, encolheu os seus pés na cama, expirou e foi congregado ao seu povo.
verses.en_web: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the spirit, and was gathered to his people.
verses.en_bbe: And when Jacob had come to the end of these words to his sons, stretching himself on his bed, he gave up his spirit, and went the way of his people.
